dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.empty: Your workspace is ready. Soon you will see your next lessons and new requests here.
dashboard.noWorkspace: No workspace is linked to this account.

funnel.title: From visit to student
funnel.lead: In the chosen period. "Converted" is the status you set on a request.

visits.title: Page visits
visits.lead: Visits of your public page per day (UTC). Search engines and your own visits are not counted.
visits.none: No visits in this period yet.

student.title: My lessons
student.empty: You have no scheduled lessons yet.

admin.title: Administration
admin.noAccess: This area is for platform staff only.

mfa.title: Set up the authenticator
mfa.lead: Platform administration needs a second step at sign-in: a code from an authenticator app on your phone (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password).
mfa.qr: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.orType: Or type this key into the app:
mfa.codeHint: The 6-digit code the app shows for ClassHub.
mfa.codesLead: Save these codes somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. They are not shown again.
mfa.againLead: This session started with the password only. Sign in again and enter the code from your app.
mfa.again: Sign out and sign in again

overview.title: Platform overview
overview.lead: Totals across ClassHub. Only numbers: no private teacher or student data.
overview.activeHint: Signed in during the last 30 days

users.title: Users
users.lead: Find an account by email or id. You see account data only, never a teacher's content.

user.metadataOnly: Account data only. Platform staff cannot open a teacher's workspace.
user.suspendLead: The account is signed out everywhere, cannot sign in, and its public site is hidden at once.
user.reactivateLead: The account can sign in again and its public site is shown again.
user.reasonHint: Required (3 to 500 characters). It is saved in the audit log.
user.grantLead: Admins manage users and see the audit log. The account is signed out and needs the authenticator to use the admin area.
user.revokeLead: The account is signed out and loses access to the admin area.
user.stepUpHint: Confirm this change with the current code from your app.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Important changes: who made them, when and to which record. Changes inside a workspace show what happened, not the data.
audit.forUser: Only entries by or about user {{id}}

security.title: Security
security.fewLeft: Few recovery codes are left. Create new ones.
security.codeHint: The current code from your app. The old recovery codes stop working.
security.replaceLead: New or lost phone? Confirm with a current code from the old app or with a recovery code, then set up the new app. The old key stops working at once.
security.proof: Current code or a recovery code
security.proofHint: A recovery code is used up.

plans.title: Plans
plans.leadOwner: Provisional limits (D-29). Changes apply to every workspace on the plan at once; nothing is deleted when a workspace is over a lower limit.
plans.leadAdmin: Provisional limits (D-29). Only the Platform Owner changes them.
plans.default: Every workspace without a paid period
plans.paid: Activated by the ClassHub team for a paid period

subscription.title: Plan
subscription.amountInvalid: Enter the amount that was paid and the payment date.
subscription.saved: Saved. The new limits apply at once.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Reports from visitors about public pages. Reporter details are for the ClassHub team only: never share them with the teacher.

hidden.title: Hidden content
hidden.lead: Content hidden by moderation. Showing it again tells the teacher.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.lead: Subjects, categories and levels teachers choose from. Entries are never deleted: deactivated ones stay where teachers already used them, but are not offered for new choices.
catalog.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; it never changes.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

codes.BAD_REQUEST: The request could not be processed.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
codes.CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this. Refresh and try again.
codes.BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION: This is not allowed by the rules.
codes.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: This content type is not supported.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
codes.ANTIFORGERY_INVALID: Your session expired. Refresh the page and try again.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: Unexpected error. Please try again later.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
codes.INVALID_TOKEN: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
codes.EMAIL_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: This email address is already confirmed.
codes.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection.
codes.IMAGE_INVALID: This image cannot be used. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo of at least 128 × 128 pixels and up to 5 MB.
codes.SLUG_TAKEN: This address is already taken. Choose another one.
codes.SITE_NOT_CREATED: Save your website once before previewing it.
codes.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Confirm your email address first (see the link in the email we sent you).
codes.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: This status change is not possible.
codes.FORM_EXPIRED: The form has expired. Reload the page.
codes.LEADS_UNAVAILABLE: Requests cannot be received at the moment.
codes.TEST_SLUG_TAKEN: Another of your tests already uses this address. Choose another one.
codes.TEST_HAS_ATTEMPTS: This test already has attempts: questions, options, correct answers, points and subject cannot change. Duplicate it to edit a new version.
codes.TEST_CHANGED: The teacher changed this test meanwhile. Reload the page and take it again.
codes.MFA_REQUIRED: Sign in with your authenticator app to continue.
codes.MFA_CODE_INVALID: The code is not valid. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
codes.SIGN_IN_EXPIRED: The sign-in has expired. Go back and sign in again.
codes.ADMIN_TARGET_FORBIDDEN: You cannot make this change to this account.
codes.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: Your plan does not allow more of this. Open Plan in the menu to see the limits and how to move to Pro.

fields.rememberMe: Keep me signed in on this device
fields.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A phrase of a few words works well.

validation.passwordTooShort: The password must have at least {{min}} characters.
validation.passwordRejected: Choose a stronger password: avoid common passwords and parts of your email address.

register.title: Create your teacher account
register.sent: If {{email}} can receive email, a confirmation link is on its way. Open it to confirm your address.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link to reset the password is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed. You were signed out everywhere; sign in with the new password.

unconfirmed.message: Please confirm your email address. Some features (such as publishing your site) need it.
unconfirmed.resent: A new confirmation link is on its way.

auth.logoutFailed: Signing out failed: {{reason}} You are still signed in.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryLead: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.

devMailbox.title: Dev mailbox
devMailbox.lead: Emails the application sent in development. Nothing here leaves this computer.
devMailbox.unavailable: The dev mailbox is not available in this environment.

profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: How students will see you. Your public page uses this information later.
profile.locationHint: Lesson times are shown in this time zone; prices use this currency.

photo.title: Profile photo
photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at least 128 × 128 pixels, up to 5 MB. Location and camera data are removed.
photo.wrongType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
photo.tooLarge: The image must be at most 5 MB.

validation.bioTooLong: The biography can have at most 1000 characters.

profile.changedElsewhere: The profile was changed elsewhere (another tab or device). Reload the page and apply your changes again.

offers.title: Offers
offers.lead: The lessons, packages and group programs you offer. Active offers can receive requests.
offers.empty: You have no offers yet. Create your first one.
offers.archiveConfirm: Archive this offer? It is hidden and cannot receive requests anymore.
offers.changedElsewhere: This offer was changed elsewhere (another tab or device). Reload the page and apply your changes again.

fields.title: Title
fields.subject: Subject
fields.priceHint: For packages: the price of the whole package. 0 for free.

validation.price: Enter a price of 0 or more, with at most two decimals.
validation.lessons: A package has between 1 and 200 lessons.
validation.seats: A group program has between 1 and 500 seats.

site.title: Website
site.lead: Your public page. Edit and save the draft, check the preview, then publish it. Visitors only see what you publish.
site.settingsHint: The address is how students find you. It must be unique.
site.previewNeedsSave: Save to preview your latest changes.
site.changedElsewhere: The website was changed elsewhere (another tab or device). Reload the page and apply your changes again.

templates.classicHint: Calm, cards on a light background.

slug.format: use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens

fields.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3–40 characters (for example ana-math).
fields.languageHint: The language visitors read; independent of your app language.
fields.headline: Headline
fields.subjectsHint: The subjects from your profile are listed below this text.
fields.offersHint: Your offers marked “show on my public page” are listed below this text.

validation.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; no hyphen at the start or end.
validation.checkFields: Some fields need attention; see the highlighted messages below.

publish.notPublishedHint: Visitors see nothing yet. Save your draft, check the preview and publish when you are ready.
publish.unpublishedChanges: You have saved changes that are not published yet. Publish them to show them to visitors.
publish.confirmUnpublish: Take your page offline? Visitors will see “page not found” until you publish again. Your draft is kept.
publish.slugMoves: Your page is published: saving a new address moves it there at once, and the old address stops working.

leads.title: Requests
leads.lead: Messages and lesson requests from your public page.
leads.empty: No requests yet. When visitors use the contact form on your public page, their requests appear here.
leads.subject: Subject
leads.changedElsewhere: This request was changed elsewhere. Reload the page and try again.
leads.noNotes: No notes yet. Only you see notes.
leads.resultNotShared: the visitor did not share the result

tests.title: Diagnostic tests
tests.lead: Free multiple-choice tests that help visitors find out where they stand.
tests.empty: No tests yet. Create one to attract new students.
tests.editorLead: Questions with several options; mark the correct ones and give points.

fields.title: Title
fields.slugHint: Optional: made from the title. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
fields.subject: Subject

statusHints.Draft: Visitors cannot see it yet. Publish it when it is ready.
statusHints.Published: Visitors can take this test (public test pages come next).
statusHints.Inactive: Taken offline. Publish it again to reopen it.

tests.noCorrectHint: Mark at least one correct option before publishing.
tests.changedElsewhere: The test was changed elsewhere. Reload the page and apply your changes again.
tests.confirmArchive: Archive this test? It disappears from the list and from the public.
tests.locked_one: This test has {{count}} attempt: you can still fix texts, the title and the description, but questions, options, correct answers, points and subject are fixed. Duplicate it to change them.
tests.locked_other: This test has {{count}} attempts: you can still fix texts, the title and the description, but questions, options, correct answers, points and subject are fixed. Duplicate it to change them.

problems.options: Question {{number}} needs at least two options and a correct one.

validation.points: Use a whole number from 0 to 100.

results.title: Results
results.shared_one: {{count}} visitor shared the result with a request.
results.shared_other: {{count}} visitors shared their result with a request.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.lead: What your plan allows. When it ends, nothing is deleted: you keep everything and only adding more is limited.
plan.upgradeText: Pro raises the limits. Online payment comes later; for now the ClassHub team activates Pro for you after your payment.

moderation.siteHidden: The ClassHub team hid your public page from visitors.
moderation.sectionsHidden: The ClassHub team hid part of your public page from visitors.
moderation.testHidden: The ClassHub team hid this test from visitors.
